（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE FILES REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 7744 Date May 22, 1937.）
Date May 22, 1937.
Subject 4th District Silk Weavers' Union - Activities.
Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by [签名]
At 11 a.m. May 21, about 70 silk weavers in the
Eastern District, led by Zung Sih-yao (鄭世堯), a secretary
of the 4th District Silk Weavers' Union, Lane 130, 138 Chining
Road, arrived at the Civic Centre. Five of the number
interviewed officials of the Shanghai City Government and
the Bureau of Social Affairs and requested assistance in
enforcing the following demands :-
（批：A. 7813/24） 1. That the Municipal Police return without delay documents
seized from the offices of the 4th District Silk Weavers'
Union on May 14.
（批：A. 7813/20） 2. That the 21 Union members now in the custody of the Municipal
Police on charges of illegal detention and intimidation
be forthwith released.
（批：A 7813/21） 3. That the Ching Sing Silk Weaving Factory, Lane 464,
24/36 Yulin Road, re-engage all old hands.
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH 24 MAY 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE） At both places they were informed that the Chinese Authorities
would investigate the matter.
A number of these weavers were, however, not
satisfied with the reply and decided to induce the weavers
in the Eastern District to go on strike. Consequently
through their agitation, a number of the weavers in the Eastern
District went on strike during the night of May 21/22 and
it is feared that the agitation may be extended.

(1) That a special office be established in the Foreign
Settlements by the Shanghai City Government to undertake
the registration of opium addicts and issuing of permits.
(2) That the opium addicts be allowed to buy opium on
production of their permits.
(3) That smuggling of opium be strictly prevented.
It is said that the authorities of the Foreign
Settlements are quite in agreement with the Chinese
authorities on principle. The detailed procedure, however,
will have to be decided after further discussions.
Taking the results obtained at the informal
conferences as a basis, Mr. O.K. Yui will write to the
authorities of the Foreign Settlements formally asking them
to carry out the measures.

Meeting of the 25th Branch Citizens' Federation

In connection with the sale of narcotics in
Hongkew and Chapei by Japanese and Korean ronins and the
assault on a policeman, the 25th Branch of the Shanghai
First Special District Citizens' Federation held an urgent
meeting at 10 a.m. yesterday, with Mr. Wei Laung-hai (韋朗軒)
in the chair, and passed the following resolutions:-
(1) That the Citizens' Federation be requested to petition
the City Government to suppress the sale of narcotics.
(2) That a letter be sent to the Police Bureau asking it to
detail additional men to take part in the campaign
against narcotic offenders and to give protection to
the residents.
(3) That a letter be sent to the authorities asking them to
instal letter boxes to enable the people to submit
secret information.
(4) That the authorities be requested to negotiate for
the punishment of the person who assaulted and severely
injured a policeman, for the issue of medical expenses,
and for an assurance against a recurrence of the
incident.

Lih Pao:-

SILK WEAVERS ISSUE MANIFESTO

As a protest against the unreasonable sealing
up of the Weavers' Union and the arbitrary arrest of workers
by the Municipal Police of the International Settlement, the
silk weavers of the 4th District of Shanghai yesterday
issued a manifesto requesting the people throughout the
country to uphold justice and to extend them unanimous
support.

Min Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram) :-

MINISTRY OF INDUSTRY WANTS FACTORY INSPECTION SETTLED

In view of the fact that the question of
inspection of factories in the International Settlement of
Shanghai is still pending, the Shanghai City Government was
again instructed on May 20 by the Ministry of Industry to
accelerate its negotiations with the S.M.C. so as to bring
about an early solution of the problem.

第二十五支市民联合会会议

鉴于日本和韩国浪人在虹口和闸北贩卖毒品并袭击警察一事，上海第一特区市民联合会第二十五支于昨日上午10时召开紧急会议，由韋朗軒（Wei Laung-hai）先生主持，并通过以下决议：-

(3) 致函当局，要求安装信箱，以便民众提交秘密情报。

实业部要求解决工厂检查问题

        At the time of the inauguration, the Union had only
a few supporters among the weavers in the Eastern District,
but through protracted agitation and propaganda it has
succeeded in increasing its membership quite considerably.
This campaign was fulfilled in March, 1937, with the advent of
the general strikes of silk weavers throughout Shanghai, when
the weavers of the Eastern District joined the Union for the
advantages to be gained by united action. With the end of
the strike on March 3 and 4, the Union gradually began to
lose favour amongst the workers until it became apparent to
them that a number of the owners had no intention of adhering
to the terms of the agreement arrived at between the workers
and employers through the mediation of the Bureau of Social
Affairs. The 4th District Silk Weavers' Union then again
commenced agitation on behalf of the workers in the hope of
securing more rigid adherence to the terms of the agreement.
        The strikers of the Ching Sing Silk Weaving Factory,
Lane 464, 24/36 Yulin Road, are now using the Union premises
as a centre for the distribution of free food.
        Among the 3,000 members of the Union, there are a
number of radicals who are continually advocating the use of
unlawful means by which to obtain recognition of their demands.
They frequently come into conflict in this respect with the

助理副督察长李义通（Lee Yee Tong），刑事侦缉队警士98号和刑事侦缉队警员321号，连同具名人前往第四区织工工会占用的房屋，在马施路同乐通138号遇见正离开工会会所的曾楚祥先生，当时他正由华德路“天华”丝厂的工人护送。

曾楚祥先生在接受询问时表示，他于1937年4月23日下午2时许被派往工会，目的是讨论“天华”工厂织工的罢工事宜，以便与厂方管理层接触。同日约下午3时，大量“庆兴”工厂的织工到达工会会所，要求他首先处理恢复“庆兴”工厂10名被解雇工人的工作一事。因未能满足他们的要求，他们威胁要殴打他，并将他囚禁至次日早晨。

Mr. Tsang Tso Chang stated he was unable to point
out the persons who threatened him and states he did
not wish to take action against them in any case.
The undersigned then interviewed the President
Standing Committee of the Union named Ho Yao (何)
and the Secretary named Tsung Shieh Yao (鄭雪堯) when
it was explained that they could not allow such acts
to go on in the Union premises. It was also drawn to
their notice that a number of pamphlets had been issued
recently bearing their Union Chop which called people
to go on strike to obtain their demands. This it was
pointed out could not go on and would ultimately lead
to the closing of the Union.
Tsang Tso Chang was escorted to the highway and
allowed to go.
Woo Yao, President of the Standing Committee of the
4th. District Weavers Union, is a dismissed 'Ching Shing'
Factory worker who was dismissed in 1936. He is now un-
employed. This was pointed out to the representative of
the Social Affairs Bureau as not being in order as the
permit granted for the forming of a Union was definitely
for employees and was not a lodging place and home for
unemployed.
Tsung Shieh Yao, Secretary of the Union is a paid
employee recommended and sent by the Local Kuomintang
Party to act as secretary. This man has never been an
employee of a silk factory.

随后，具名人采访了工会常务委员会主席何尧（Ho Yao，何）和秘书郑雪尧（Tsung Shieh Yao，鄭雪堯），并向他们解释，不能允许此类行为在工会会所内继续发生。同时提请注意，最近散发了一些盖有该工会印章的小册子，号召人们罢工以获取其诉求。对此指出，这种行为不能继续下去，最终将导致工会被关闭。
曾楚祥被护送至大路并获准离开。
第四区织工工会常务委员会主席吴尧（Woo Yao，原文如此，前文为何尧）是一名于1936年被解雇的“庆兴”工厂工人。他目前失业。这一点已向社局代表指出，认为此举不合规定，因为批准成立工会的许可明确是针对在职雇员的，而非作为失业者的寄宿处和家园。
工会秘书郑雪尧是由当地国民党推荐并派遣担任秘书的受薪雇员。此人从未在任何丝织厂做过雇员。

4th District Silk Weaving Factory Workers' Union -
Inaugurated

The 4th District Silk Weaving Factory Workers' Union
was inaugurated during a meeting held in the Young Men's
Lecturing Group Society Building, Chung Hwa Road, Nantao,
in the afternoon of December 20. About 600 Chinese
including delegates from the local Tangpu, the Bureau of
Social Affairs and the General Labour Union attended.

During the meeting, union regulations were passed,
and an executive committee of seven members and a supervisory
committee of three persons were elected.

This union has an office at 17 Teh An Li (德安里),
Thorburn Road.

第四区丝织厂工人工会 -
成立

第四区丝织厂工人工会于12月20日下午在南市中华路青年宣讲团社大楼举行的会议上成立。约600名中国人出席，包括当地党部、社会局和总工会的代表。

会议期间，通过了工会章程，并选举产生了由七名成员组成的执行委员会和由三人组成的监察委员会。

该工会在韬朋路德安里17号设有办事处。
